name: s81su_smhq-s81su_smhq-COMMIT
purpose: S81U-SMH2: lane-quad regional cluster (x4 per head) of the S81-DV per-head SM subtree (bench: tools/s81_su_sm/sms_bench.sh SMT=1; su_gate.py run --hier --smu with OT_SU_VDEFS=-DSU_SMU_T).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; dsfd_su_t_smhq u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/su_sm/dsfd_su_t_smhq.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81su_smhq/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81su_smhq/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81su_smhq --out {RUN}/record/views/dsfd_su_t_smhq --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_smd_u65_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_smd --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81su_sml_u65_ref/views/dsfd_su_t_sml > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-SMH2 (10-17): the g2 single per-head cluster s81su_smh (1,037 x 769 um, ONE clock pin: TT insertion 1.04-1.29 ns, spread 249 ps; setup -646 ps rst_in unregistered to 26 children, -330 ps one relay -> a lane 1 mm away) is split into regional clusters: 4 lane quads (this kit, x4 per head: lanes 4q..4q+3 + divide pairs 2q, 2q+1, which read only those operand lanes) + 1 root s81su_smhr. Own clock pin beside the S register band, own registered reset relay (rst_in loads = 2 synchroniser flops), every inter-cluster hop registered at both ends (SRL stations split across the hop: same cycles as ot_s81_su_smh). Deepest child 395 um from the pin face (was 741). SMHKP4 10-18: the closed 65b8808ea view failed the native audit (capture 442 > 190 on all 341 inputs) because the GRT-stage io_ref re-reference lost the input pin flops (port -> INHOLD driver -> HB2 pad -> CTS hold buffers = more than the 3-hop pin-flop search) and fell back to the first register, the hard child clock pin g_l[0].u_sml/ck (TT 360 ps vs the pin flops 612 ps): input min delay ~250 ps early, so GRT hold repair padded every input by ~250 ps (3,756 hold buffers). The inputs ARE registered at the pins (OT_IOFLOP 340 input flops fixed at their pins; no cycle change needed). Fix: refglob u_t* names the tap input pin-flop group (median reference) at every stage.

reroute_reason.why: SMHKP4 10-18 (lanes/S81-SMHKP4.md): native capture 441.9 > 190 on all 341 inputs: GRT io_ref pin-flop search (3 hops) lost the input pin flops behind INHOLD driver + HB2 pad + CTS hold buffers and fell back to the hard-child clock pin g_l[0].u_sml/ck (~250 ps early) -> 3,756 GRT hold buffers ~250 ps per input
reroute_reason.fix: refglob u_t* names the tap input pin-flop group as the IO reference at every stage (same RTL, outline, pins); gate WARN 0 fail spread 27.7/21.3, GRT 0
